Decision: Implement three independent Windows 11 local Group Policy registry settings for future BitLocker encryption: operating-system, fixed-data and removable-data drives. Retain the historical EncryptionMethod operation unchanged.

MicrosoftReferences.Use: Documents Group Policy choice of algorithm/cipher strength separately for OS, fixed-data and removable-data drives; says an unconfigured policy defaults new encryption to XTS-AES 128-bit; policy takes effect when encryption starts.

Documents the four supported values 3/4/6/7 and the separate CSP requirement to provide all three drive-type selections together in SyncML. RIDE does not use this CSP; it writes one local Group Policy registry value per selected operation.

LocalPolicyDefinitionObservation.Boundary: This is a read-only observation of the current host policy-definition file plus Microsoft documentation. It is not disposable Windows target acceptance and does not prove policy precedence or actual volume conversion behavior.

DefaultProfile.PreviousIntent: AES-CBC 256-bit from the retained legacy selector.
DefaultProfile.CurrentIntent: XTS-AES 256-bit for OS, fixed-data and removable-data drive policies.
DefaultProfile.Scope: Future encryption only. This declarative profile change did not run on the host.
